_comment: The Exclude array below IS this check's declaration of what it does not
examine, not a mirror of one. The runner reads it -- extract_editorconfig
in scripts/lib/scope.sh -- and turns each entry into a git pathspec
exclusion; editorconfig-checker reads it too, so a by-hand invocation
Exclude holds REGEXES, not globs -- different syntax from every other
declaration in this repository, which is why the dots are escaped and the
directory patterns anchored with ^. A glob written here would silently
